description: A text message from the client at counter 0. `hex` is the whole binary WebSocket frame (the box of a record, nothing else); `decoded` is what opening it with the `box.before` key from keys.json and the `nonce` yields: record kind byte then payload. The counter and nonce never travel on the wire.
